title: Minimum Window Substring
keyIdea: Grow a window with right and count how many of t's letters it covers (found). Once it covers all of t, drop letters from the left that the window has extra of, record the window if it's the shortest, and keep going. Each index enters and leaves once: O(m + n).

approaches.name: Brute force: every start
approaches.idea: For each start i, extend j until the window covers t, record its length, and move to the next start.
approaches.why: Each start can scan to the end of s.

approaches.name: Sliding window with found counter
approaches.idea: freqS[s[right]]++, found++ if still needed. When found == t.length(), drop extra letters from the left, then update the shortest window.
approaches.why: right and left each move at most m times; the maps hold at most the distinct letters.

quiz.q: Why can left skip a letter while freqS > freqT?
options: The window has extra copies of it, so it still covers t without that one
